additional_context: Device remains active in the current build through source/fhir.ini. The old STU3 Device.udi.jurisdiction content is represented today as Device.udiCarrier.jurisdiction in source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml. The 2021 source rework from the spreadsheet to structuredefinition-Device.xml preserved the corrected wording, and targeted Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches did not reveal a related or conflicting decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative Device source already says "All UDIs are globally unique within a single namespace with the appropriate repository uri as the system" without the erroneous full stop, and source search found no remaining occurrence of the bad punctuation.
